name: Compiler Tooling Inflection-Architecture Coverage
description: Bundle 6 substantive coverage gaps + 1 close-out for compiler tooling specifically designed around Inflection-architecture patterns (Lambda-bundled silver scripts, multi-firm shared infrastructure, marker-constant contracts spread across 30+ files, EventBridge S3-event chains, 9-dim quorum). Goal: get compiler tooling ahead of the architecture rather than chasing each gap reactively. Anchored on 6 same-week incidents + Andrew 2026-05-08 exchange 'are our compilers adequately designed for the inflection pipeline'.

prds.label: ADHC_COMPIL_V4 PRD v0.1 + v0.2 + v0.3 + section 14 OPS + section 15 v0.5 + section 16 post-v0.5 retrospective

source_brief: 1.0.0_SA_CTO architectural assessment 2026-05-08 + 6 anchor incidents from same-week Inflection sprint (INFETL.CHAININC, AUDIT-003 partial-coverage, INFNNA rep_id=6 sync, ROUTER-DRIFT false-drift, FIRMSEP.02 layer-mismatch, DAILY-AUDIT hand-authoring) + Andrew direct: 'are our compilers adequately designed for the inflection pipeline'
phase: COMPLETE 2026-05-18 (3-step closure, 1.0.0_SA_CTO). Goal achieved -- compiler tooling brought ahead of the Inflection architecture rather than chasing each gap reactively. Phase 1 (v0.1-v0.4 + section-14 OPS) = 21/21 TOs shipped, incl. TO-017 operational test matrix + segment-scope taxonomy. v0.5 wave = 9/9 tools shipped (.025-.033: comp-pipescript skipgate / postmerge-cols / shadow-detect, comp-types index, comp-validate gold-nan + the safe_json_serialize shared util, comp-blast --check-consumers, comp-adapter-audit, comp-perf vectorize-audit, comp-coverage report); backends 702fe31c5, AE wrappers 3eb389704, pushed 9ea03e512; .029a safe_json_serialize confirmed shipped e0f51a147. Task #22 post-v0.5 retrospective shipped as PRD section 16 (2b81783c4) -- empirical-anchor discipline confirmed held (every v0.5 tool cleared a per-TO anchor-reproduction AC). comp-graph resolver fix 9681e35d4 folded as a non-gating increment. The standing quarterly-retrospective cadence (PRD section 13) carries forward as CTO protocol, not project scope.
depends_on_note: Independent project. Cross-coordinates with ADVI_INFETL (TO-5 auto-renders the DAILY-AUDIT matrix), ADVI_INFNNA (TO-3 indexes INFLECTION_REP_IDS), ADVI_FIRMSEP (TO-6 reuses the cross-firm view that FIRMSEP.10 Cottonwood onboarding will need). All cross-coords are tooling-consumes-current-state, not blocking dependencies.
